source_text: In Butemba, kdr-L1014S (kdr-east) frequencies were 94.7 % (n = 113) in A. gambiae s.s.; no susceptible individuals were observed.
The few A. arabiensis analysed (n = 7) were all susceptible.
In Aduku, A. gambiae s.s. showed a high L1014S frequency of 81 % (n = 13)
while for A. arabiensis frequency was 3 % (n = 252).
